name: sudus
description: The referee for agent-led software development: reads the repository, names the next action.

view.title: Where the Sudus verdict shows
view.description: "status-line" (default): one line under the prompt. "pane": a pane beside the transcript with the face. "both". "off": nothing. Needs function hooks (early access).

face.title: Blobatar face
face.description: The text the face is drawn from; blobatar draws the same face from the same text every time. "sudus" is built in; any other text is fetched from blobatar.dev once per session.

asciiFace.title: ASCII face in the status line
asciiFace.description: Put a small ASCII face in the same expression before the status line.

command.title: sudus command
command.description: The command the status line runs; "sudus" on PATH by default, and this plugin's own copy when that cannot start.
